en:
## New Features

- Native Windows ARM64 releases, with architecture-verified ripgrep and zstd helpers and updated third-party notices
- Move a running Bash command into the background without interrupting it, with tool-row actions and drill-down from activity traces
- Scheduled tasks can retain only the latest N narrators or clean up old sessions; active work and unrelated sessions stay protected
- Refresh MCP tool lists individually or together without unnecessary reconnects, with visible partial failures
- Opt-in built-in skill-creator guidance and project-level overrides that can disable globally enabled skills
- Configurable disk-space warnings and write protection, with snapshots and request dumps degrading safely when space runs low
- Scroll overflowing terminal tabs horizontally with the mouse wheel

## Performance

- Navigation resizing now limits style recalculation to affected layout nodes and restores transitions reliably after dragging
- Narrator header controls adapt to width changes without rerendering the entire conversation panel

## Bug Fixes

- Provider-plugin request dumps now redact secrets across stream chunks and retries, including encoded forms
- Improved provider-plugin RPC compatibility, Codex HTTP turn-state continuity, and subagent model inheritance and resume handling
- History-only retry rollback preserves file checkpoints for later explicit file restoration
- Session titles use the user's request rather than expanded skill documentation
- Automated reflection has a distinct indigo shield and status label instead of looking like an ordinary permission wait
- Linux helper builds no longer require a private proxy and reject binaries with the wrong CPU architecture
- Fixed standalone subagent completion publication passing an asynchronous callback into a synchronous SQLite transaction
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 支持原生 Windows ARM64 发布包，配套 ripgrep、zstd 辅助程序校验架构并补齐第三方协议声明
- 运行中的 Bash 命令可无中断转入后台，支持工具行操作及从活动轨迹进入工具详情
- 定时任务支持仅保留最新 N 个叙述者或清理过期会话，保护活动任务和无关会话
- MCP 工具列表支持单独或批量刷新，避免不必要的重连并明确提示部分失败
- 新增默认关闭的内置 skill-creator 编写指导，项目可屏蔽全局启用的技能
- 可配置磁盘空间告警与写入保护，低空间时快照和请求 dump 安全降级
- 终端标签溢出时可用鼠标滚轮横向滚动

## 性能优化

- 导航栏拖动宽度时仅重算相关布局节点，拖动结束或异常中断后可靠恢复过渡效果
- 叙述者顶栏随宽度自适应，不再带动整个对话面板反复渲染

## 修复

- 插件提供商请求 dump 的密钥脱敏覆盖跨分块、跨重试及编码内容
- 完善插件提供商 RPC 兼容性，修正 Codex HTTP 轮次状态及子代理模型继承和续跑处理
- 仅回退历史后重试会保留文件检查点，仍可显式恢复文件
- 会话标题基于用户请求生成，不再误用展开后的技能介绍
- 自动反思使用独立的靛蓝盾牌与状态文字，不再与普通权限等待混淆
- Linux 辅助程序构建不再依赖私网代理，并拒绝错误 CPU 架构的产物
- 修复独立子代理结论提交把异步回调传入 SQLite 同步事务的问题
